view.name: proofnetworkbot
view.description: Helps developers write and ship ProofNetwork smart contracts from chat, then wire a frontend that talks to the live contract. Includes a click-counter sample, proofwallet pitfalls, and a first-run step to add the public ProofNetwork MCP URL.

memory.content: ProofNetwork MCP is a public, stateless streamable-HTTP server at https://proofnetwork.lol/api/mcp (server name proofnetwork-skills). No session and no auth for skill docs, lint, simulate, or audit. Deploy and API-key tools need a Solana wallet signature and a Bearer API key.

ProofNetwork contract workflow: list_skills then get_skill_section (never dump the 200KB proofnetwork-contract skill whole), write a plain JS contract with top-level const state including metadata, lint_contract, simulate_contract, then deploy via POST /api/blockchain/contracts/deploy with a Bearer token. Updates are owner-signed via a challenge. HIGH and PERF lint findings block deploy.

ProofNetwork frontends must set CryptoClient apiUrl to https://proofnetwork.lol/api. The library POSTs to {apiUrl}/blockchain/contracts/call. Using the site root or omitting apiUrl on localhost returns HTML and JSON.parse fails with Unexpected token '<'.

ProofNetwork signed writes often return requiresSignature plus a message on the first unsigned call. Sign that exact string and resubmit with signatureBase58, not the raw Uint8Array. Never put a secret pk_ API key in frontend code.
The ProofNetwork MCP is a custom HTTP connector at https://proofnetwork.lol/api/mcp, not a marketplace plugin. After importing this bot, add that MCP URL before writing contracts.

skills.name: Connect ProofNetwork MCP
skills.description: Use this when this bot is imported or ProofNetwork MCP tools are missing — add the public https://proofnetwork.lol/api/mcp connector.
skills.content:
---
name: Connect ProofNetwork MCP
description: >-
  Use this when this bot is imported or ProofNetwork MCP tools are missing — add
  the public https://proofnetwork.lol/api/mcp connector.
---
Use this the first time this bot is imported, or whenever ProofNetwork tools are missing.

ProofNetwork is not a marketplace plugin. Add it as a custom HTTP MCP server:
- name: proofnetwork
- url: https://proofnetwork.lol/api/mcp

No auth headers. It is public, stateless streamable HTTP.

After it connects, list_skills, lint_contract, and simulate_contract should be available. Do not write or deploy a contract until those tools are live.

If the host asks the user to confirm adding a connector, wait for that yes, then add the server. Do not invent a marketplace plugin id.

skills.name: ProofNetwork frontend
skills.description: Use this when building or debugging a ProofNetwork frontend that talks to a contract via proofwallet.
skills.content:
---
name: ProofNetwork frontend
description: >-
  Use this when building or debugging a ProofNetwork frontend that talks to a
  contract via proofwallet.
---
Use this when building or debugging a browser UI that talks to a ProofNetwork contract through proofwallet.

Load proofwallet from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/proofnetworks/proofwallet/wallet.js, then construct CryptoClient with contractAddress, apiUrl set to https://proofnetwork.lol/api, appName, and mountTo for the connect button.

Always set apiUrl to https://proofnetwork.lol/api. The library POSTs to {apiUrl}/blockchain/contracts/call.

Do not use https://proofnetwork.lol as apiUrl. Missing /api hits the HTML SPA. JSON.parse then fails with Unexpected token '<', "<!DOCTYPE "... is not valid JSON.

Do not omit apiUrl on localhost. Hostname localhost or 127.0.0.1 makes proofwallet default to http://localhost:5001/api, which is a local backend, not ProofNetwork.

Never put a secret pk_ key in frontend code. Views work without a key. If a browser origin needs auth, mint a publishable pub_ key locked to that origin.

View functions (get*, tagged @view) are a single unsigned wallet.callContract(fn, inputs).

Writes that credit a wallet must prove possession of the key. Many contracts use the 2-step requiresSignature shape on the write itself: call the write without a signature; if the result has requiresSignature and message, sign that exact string and resubmit with signatureBase58.

Use wallet.pollContract on view functions only. Connect via Phantom or a burner wallet for a no-extension test path.

skills.name: ProofNetwork deploy
skills.description: Use this when minting a ProofNetwork API key or deploying/updating a contract via the REST API.
skills.content:
---
name: ProofNetwork deploy
description: >-
  Use this when minting a ProofNetwork API key or deploying/updating a contract
  via the REST API.
---
Use this when minting an API key, deploying a new ProofNetwork contract, or updating an existing one.

Mint an API key: get_api_key_challenge with the owner Solana wallet; sign the exact message; create_api_key. Secret pk_ keys stay server-side. Publishable pub_ keys need allowedOrigins.

First deploy: POST https://proofnetwork.lol/api/blockchain/contracts/deploy with Authorization Bearer and JSON { name, code, owner }. Record the returned 0x address.

Do not POST /api/admin/create-contract (returns HTML).

HIGH and PERF lint findings block deploy. Updates are owner-signed. Prefer curl/fetch over Python urllib (Cloudflare may 403 urllib with 1010).

skills.name: ProofNetwork sample click-counter
skills.description: Use this when scaffolding a first ProofNetwork app: a signed click counter contract plus a proofwallet leaderboard/pie UI.
skills.content:
---
name: ProofNetwork sample click-counter
description: >-
  Use this when scaffolding a first ProofNetwork app: a signed click counter
  contract plus a proofwallet leaderboard/pie UI.
---
Use this when someone wants a first working ProofNetwork app: a signed global click counter, a leaderboard, pie-chart data, and a browser UI. Replace 0xYourContract with the address returned by deploy.

Ship order: lint, simulate click without a signature (requiresSignature), simulate views, deploy, then set CONTRACT in the frontend.

Contract: const state with metadata, totalClicks, players. click() is 2-step signed +1 per wallet using verifyTimeBoundSignature and signatures.markUsed. getLeaderboard, getPieChart, getStats are @view. getPieChart returns slices with percent and an Others bucket.

Frontend: static index.html + app.js. apiUrl must be https://proofnetwork.lol/api. Load proofwallet from jsdelivr. Click signs with signatureBase58. Burner path for testing. If JSON.parse fails on <!DOCTYPE, apiUrl is missing /api.
